response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount, AVG(ABS(inholdpct - instownpct)) AS avg_ownership_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_gap) AS overall_avg_gap FROM g) SELECT g.corpeventprx, g.avg_anlycount, g.avg_ownership_gap, g.avg_ownership_gap - o.overall_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL
